- 添加环形遮罩使整体呈现完美圆形
- 照片保持固定尺寸填充

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
feat: 改为行列网格布局，1:1缩略图裁剪显示

- 照片按网格行列排列，无间隔
- 缩略图1:1比例居中裁剪
- 点击显示原图
- 圆形遮罩保持整体圆形外观

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''

- 移除200张限制

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''

- 默认 15x15 网格的占位符

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
feat: 添加管理面板、二维码上传和太阳光效
